note: RF01-RF16 (ADR-003 review) and RF17-RF19 (amendment of 2026-10-15), unchanged. A ticked item, or (general-adult-3) an item the red-flag screen finds in the person's own words, stops the consultation before guidance (A15).
prompt: Do any of these apply to you right now?

messages.emergency: Call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait for this consultation.
messages.urgent_clinician: Contact a clinician or urgent care today. Do not wait for a routine appointment.

red_flags.text: Chest pain or pressure, or pain spreading to the arm, jaw or back, especially with sweating or shortness of breath
Sudden face drooping, weakness or numbness of an arm or leg, trouble speaking or understanding, or sudden loss of vision
Severe difficulty breathing, or blue or grey lips
A sudden, severe headache, the worst you have ever had
Fainting or passing out, or new confusion
Swelling of the face, lips or tongue, or throat tightness
Vomiting blood, or black, tarry or bloody stools
Heavy bleeding that does not stop
Sudden or severe pain in the belly
Thoughts of suicide, or of harming yourself or someone else
Fever with a stiff neck, or with a rash that does not fade when pressed
Pregnant, with bleeding or severe pain
A serious injury, such as a head injury followed by vomiting or drowsiness, or a possible broken bone
A painful, swollen calf or leg
Fever of 39.5 °C (103 °F) or higher for more than 3 days, or being unable to keep fluids down
Skin redness that is spreading, with fever
New numbness around the groin, buttocks or inner thighs, or back pain with new difficulty starting to urinate or loss of bladder or bowel control
